authorization: Explicit user command to activate C02 via OP-01/OP-02, A1 pilot and safe rollout, 2026-10-31
owner_goal: Evidence-backed finite acceptance, no claim of 100 percent perfection
precedence: Narrow amendment to LINGUISTIC-QA-AUTHORITY-POLICY.json and advisory combination gate: 100 percent mechanical; independent method, all critical/high semantic/source risks adjudicated; low-risk stratified sample with calibrated escalation. Historical signed-off decisions reused only if source hash/field dependencies match. Does not relax original source, Stage3 completeness, Stage5/6/7, exact runtime, UI, SRS or LOCKED.

definition_of_done.low_medium: independent stratified sample, rooted in source evidence
definition_of_done.systemic_error: Review all affected family and resample before PASS
definition_of_done.reopening: Only material new evidence, changed exact content/dependencies or proven systematic regression; no endless speculative additional checks

risk_classes.CRITICAL: fabricated/incorrect original source, content corruption, identity/data loss
risk_classes.HIGH: demonstrable sense, grammatical rection, translation mismatch or misleading didactic relation
risk_classes.MEDIUM: context ambiguity or local translation risk
risk_classes.LOW: stylistic paraphrase, short phrase, overlap with example
risk_classes.INFO: advisory only, not a demonstrated defect

scanner_contract.low_risk_family_group_closeout: Allowed only with all affected exact IDs, typed rule, independent representative evidence; no blanket approval

sampling.other_profiles: Declare valid strata per source/domain; no invented combinations for nonlexical Grammar/Lesen/Schreiben
sampling.low_risk_pass_condition: Source-checked sample decisions and separate adversarial method; otherwise fail closed

evidence.prior_receipt_reuse: only when exact bytes or dependency crosswalk validated
evidence.reviewer_claims: AI separate-method, never fabricated outside specialist

rollout.other_workstreams: POLICY_AVAILABLE_ON_NEXT_SAFE_STAGE4_BOUNDARY_AFTER_TECHNICAL_TESTS; each must pass its own evidence gate

reference.tests: 12/12 LOCAL SYNTHETIC, 11 focused adversarial plus synthetic positive; real A1 shadow BLOCKED
